item.title: Norman C. Francis, civil rights champion and recipient of Presidential Medal of Freedom, dies at 94
item.description: Norman C. Francis, a civil rights pioneer, champion of education and leader who was charged with helping rebuild New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina, died Wednesday. Francis was 94. Francis paved the way for Black students and professionals as the first Black student at Loyola University’s law school and through his work in the U.S. Attorney General’s office to help integrate federal agencies. item.title: Air Force One will be painted red, white and blue as Trump has hinted, US military says
item.description: The U.S. military says a red, white and blue color scheme championed by President Donald Trump will become the new look for Air Force One.
